pitfalls: Keep the GPU cache off (cache_dir=":nocache" in Python, --disable_cache=true in the command-line tool): on a Mac, runs that loaded an earlier run's GPU program cache answered wrongly (card L68).
One Engine per conversation: the Mamba-2 state is not reset between conversations (LiteRT-LM #3165) (card L69).
Tool calls come back as text (the model's <tool_call> form) (card L70).
Long replies: a blocking send_message still generating after 10 minutes fails with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; use send_message_async or cap max_output_tokens (card L71).
After a message overflows the context window, every later message in that conversation fails (Task failed with state: 7); start a new conversation (card L72).

GPU: the card runs it with the v0.19.1 command-line tool built from source, which has --sampler_handles_input=false (the PyPI package does not); LiteRT-LM 0.18.0's GPU moe op only supports activation 'gelu'. CPU: the PyPI package, litert-lm 0.19.1 (card L27, L76-L93).
Thinking is on by default; thinking_config=litert_lm.ThinkingConfig(enable_thinking=False) in create_conversation turns it off (card L29, L105).

The card's checks (12 questions and a three-turn chat, a name then 17 × 23, greedy, against NVIDIA's bf16 weights): with thinking on, 12/12 right and 391 for 17 × 23 on all four files on the CPU and the GPU (the source model was not run with thinking on); with thinking off, 11/12 right, as the source model, and 17 × 23 comes back as 401 for the mixed_int4 files (this one among them) and for the source model, 391 on the CPU and 411 on the GPU for the int4 files (card L59-L64).

Which file: this one gives faster CPU prefill than int4 ekv4096 (card L38). On an Apple M4 Max (128 GB) its benchmark peaked at 23.2 GB on the GPU and 6.9 GB on the CPU (2026-11-12); speed still being tuned (updates follow) (card L27, L52-L53, L55).
